category_edits.rationale: Soften tied item embedding normalization to e/max(||e||,1e-12)^0.9 for history and candidates across all four datasets. This permits modest learned norm variation while preserving zero padding, dimensions, GRU topology, scoring, loss, optimizer, and one checkpoint per category.

edits.replace:
norms = torch.linalg.vector_norm(embeddings, ord=2, dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        embeddings = embeddings / norms.clamp(min=1e-12).pow(0.9)

change_summary: Apply power-0.9 embedding normalization and synchronize metadata validation in the embedded predictor, which imports the updated model class.
